name: tool-call
title: Tool call
description: One thing an agent did, folded by default: the tool's name, a lamp and a word for queued, running, done or failed, a summary; open, its input as label and value pairs and its result in a sunk well, or the error, or the tool's own UI. Consecutive calls fold under one group row.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tool-call.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolCall in the MetalUI Swift package.
